I brought the car for its original appointment in which the I was not informed that it was cancelled due to them running behind. Brought it to the next appointment in which they were still running behind and I had to wait 2 hours extra. Got the car washed by another detailer in its 3 months of existing, no scratches. I brought it here cause they are cheaper.Bring it to this detailer in which afterwards there are scratches on the hood and under the side mirror. Mind you these are hard scratches to get from road debris. They said they would polish it out and have been waiting three weeks via cancelled appointments and the owner not communicating at all. Got a call today only for the owner to get into a screaming match with me saying their detailer make no mistakes and they didn’t scratch the car. Soap was left under the mirrors the residue formed. Terrible experience. If you soon into the second picture you can clearly see scratches going up and down which I’m sure is due to the cleaning motion.

To reply to the owners reply. I told you to zoom into the second picture a few days later because I noticed the scratches. Upon zooming in those scratches were there and that was after the wash. This was not done by previous work as I would have complained as I am to you now. You were not kind at all  and told me you would not fix the other scratches please do not lie. Microfiber towels and mitts can cause deep scratches if not cleaned properly, a simple Google review proves that, Seeing as there are previous reviews with bad ratings and pictures of scratches mistakes can happen. But you refused to fix any mistake on mine and argued that this was not your fault. Seeing as how you failed to complete promised scheduled appointments and the appointments to fix said scratches your work is not reliable at all. Therefore your word is also most likely unreliable.

I would recommend Going to another diesel repair shop.   There is a strong lack of communication at this place   And they are  Fully competent when it comes to the trucks that their site says that they service.  I initially had an initial good experience at this place when I was first recommended by after that, it went quickly downhill   My last experience  Was I brought the truck into them for a rear door replacement.  We have a tight service schedule and we do not have a lot of trucks so we can’t afford a lot of downtime and I’ve spoke with the initial guy about doing it over the weekend because he said that they were open.  I also specified to the first guy that I was bringing it in for a door only and I do not need an oil change.  I had just put $300 worth of Titan additives into my engine To help stop the flow of the leaking oil .  Because this place did not have a good solution for the leaking oil  Without potentially thousands of dollars worth of repair and investigative problem-solving    Which tells me that they do not know that particular motor very well and I felt uncomfortable with them doing investigative Motor Repair if they did not have a clear picture of what was going wrong to start with .  That first weekend, one of my guys who was supposed to bring the truck in did not end up making it in    So I called back the next week and let them know that we will be bringing it in this weekend .  I did not go into further explanation on what it was going to be serviced on this truck because that full detail was covered from the previous week    When we went to go pick the truck up on Monday morning   We were shocked to find the backdoor still in the state of disrepair that we left it   And that they had done the oil change that was specifically requested not to be done.  When I have confronted the shop about this issue   They said they were not going to charge me for the oil change, but they declined to do any further business.  Piss poor way to handle business in Dallas Fort Worth if you want to maintain a reputation.  My strong recommendation if you have an Isuzu diesel box truck   Is that you take it to industrial power  Or anywhere else because of my experience on how they treat you, you will end up spending way more money and not getting your problem solved

Don't be fooled by employee reviews. My truck never ran more than 200 miles after leaving their shop 3 times. If you need a PM they are good I guess. If you need a solid repair and diagnosis, prepare to be disappointed unless it is an easy fix.
